description: Part-load efficiency with flue gas enthalpy loss, auxiliary power curve, and stack temperature model. Extends F1a by explicit flue-gas and auxiliary energy balance.

unit.name: Generic 500 MW Subcritical PC Plant (540 C / 160 bar)
unit.source: Booras & Holt (2004), EPRI; IEA CCC/168 (2010); Borgnakke & Sonntag (2009), Fundamentals of Thermodynamics, 7th ed.; Barroso, J. et al. (2006). Fuel, 85(3), 248-258.

eta_iso.note: Net LHV efficiency at rated ISO (PLR=1, T_amb=15C)

T_stack_rated_c.note: Flue gas stack temperature at rated load (above acid dew point ~120C)

T_stack_partload_offset_c.note: Stack temperature rise at minimum load (PLR=0.3): less heat absorption

T_amb_standard_c.note: Ambient for flue gas loss calculation baseline

stoich_air_kg_per_kg_coal.note: Stoichiometric air requirement (bituminous coal); excess air ~20%

aux_power_rated_pct.note: Auxiliary power at rated load (fans, pumps, mills): ~6-8% of gross

aux_power_partload_extra_pct.note: Extra auxiliary power fraction at minimum PLR (fans inefficiency at turndown)
